name: Vasudev Siddh
headline: AI & Full-Stack Engineer
summary: AI engineering intern and open-source developer working across real-time voice, LLM applications, and full-stack systems. Creator of JustHireMe, an AI job-intelligence workbench with 2,200+ GitHub stars.

bullets: Work across conversational AI, real-time voice, and full-stack development using Python, TypeScript, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, and WebRTC.

Work on applied AI and backend development using Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, Node.js, and MongoDB; focus on embeddings, vector retrieval, and multimodal AI.
Contribute to API integration, automated testing, containerized workflows, and CI/CD using Docker and AWS.

projects.name: JustHireMe
projects.label: Creator / Open source
bullets: Built a local-first desktop workbench for discovering jobs, explaining role fit, and preparing tailored application drafts; grew the public project to 2,200+ GitHub stars.
Combined graph and vector retrieval, deterministic lead-quality checks, and human review of generated documents.

projects.name: Odeon
projects.label: Solo build / Agent evaluation
bullets: Built an evaluation loop that simulates adversarial conversations, scores agent behavior with an LLM judge, and rewrites prompts against per-metric thresholds.
Streamed simulation results over WebSockets; added persisted run history and word-level prompt diffs to inspect each optimization cycle.

projects.name: Waldo
projects.label: Solo build / Multimodal RAG
bullets: Built PDF retrieval across text, tables, and figures using OCR, vision-model descriptions, and embeddings linked to page and image metadata.
Implemented relevance grading, bounded query-rewrite retries, and a no-context refusal path; surfaced supporting figures in a React chat interface.
